title: 05｜客户端首字交付与兜底体验
description: 业务首token：用户提交到第一个token实际显示，包含首发等待和兜底全过程。按所选型号统计，缺报不补0，无AI自动调参。

list.name: measurement
list.label: 观测口径
list.query: 首字交付 v4 : client_committed_v4,历史屏幕观测 v3 : visible_dom_after_frame_v3,历史 v2 : visible_dom_after_frame_v2,历史 v1 : visible_dom_after_frame_v1

list.name: model
list.label: 型号
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id) || ' [' || requested_model_id || ']' AS __text, requested_model_id AS __value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (measurement_method IS NULL AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v3' AND recoverable_delivery) OR (NOT recoverable_delivery AND client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))))) GROUP BY requested_model_id ORDER BY 1

options.content:
**重点看两项**：①前台首字交付超时率，目标1%；②点击到首token进入消息界面的耗时分布（含已开启的思考）。

v4从点击计时，到React提交含首token的消息界面为止；不要求文字在当前视口，也不宣称用户已经阅读。网络收到只是排查分段，不代替客户端交付。默认首发派发4秒无首字启动兜底，首发继续竞争；两路共享原10秒总截止，先出有效首字者交付，败方立即停止。2秒是前置过慢时提前启动兜底的预留，不是兜底自身时限。

每轮首份结果固定：到截止仍未交付即超时，迟到恢复不改成成功。离页/后台中断观测，后台继续生成；离页、后台、缺报、手动停止均单列，不混入前台成功或超时分母。成功分布仅含截止前交付；必须结合超时与缺报一起看。历史v1/v2/v3独立选择，不与v4合并。

“首发等待”现表示启动兜底阈值；“兜底预留时间”沿用原配置字段。按实际生产上线时刻分窗：上线前该字段仍表示旧兜底硬时限，不因参数同为4/2/10而合并前后策略。

panels.title: 前台首字交付超时率 · 各型号
panels.description: 前台已知结果（成功交付、时间截断、其他上游失败）中，首字阶段超时或总截止仍未提交token的比例。v4早收到但晚提交仍计超时，迟到恢复不改写；离页、后台、手动停止和缺报均排除并单列。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), concat(COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id), ' [', requested_model_id, ']') AS metric, 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE ((recoverable_delivery AND client_delivery_failed) OR (NOT recoverable_delivery AND client_outcome='timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (measurement_method IS NULL AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v3' AND recoverable_delivery) OR (NOT recoverable_delivery AND client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,requested_model_id UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), '监控目标' AS metric, 100.0*max(timeout_rate_target) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (measurement_method IS NULL AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v3' AND recoverable_delivery) OR (NOT recoverable_delivery AND client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 点击 → 客户端首token交付（含思考）· 耗时分布
panels.description: v4仅统计前台、截止前首token进入已提交消息界面的成功样本；不要求在当前视口。成功分布不含超时/迟到恢复，须与超时率及缺报一起看。历史版本保留原测量定义。

targets.rawSql:
WITH samples AS (SELECT client_first_token_visible_ms AS ms FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (measurement_method IS NULL AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v3' AND recoverable_delivery) OR (NOT recoverable_delivery AND client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false AND (measurement_method IS DISTINCT FROM 'client_committed_v4' OR client_first_token_visible_ms < first_token_deadline_ms)),
bins(ord,label,lo,hi) AS (VALUES (1,'0–1秒',0,1000),(2,'1–2秒',1000,2000),(3,'2–3秒',2000,3000),(4,'3–4秒',3000,4000),(5,'4–6秒',4000,6000),(6,'6–8秒',6000,8000),(7,'8–10秒',8000,10000),(8,'10秒及以上',10000,NULL))
SELECT b.label AS "点击到首token", 100.0*count(s.ms)/NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM samples),0) AS "成功交付样本占比"
FROM bins b LEFT JOIN samples s ON s.ms>=b.lo AND (b.hi IS NULL OR s.ms<b.hi) WHERE (${measurement:sqlstring}<>'client_committed_v4' OR b.ord<8) GROUP BY b.ord,b.label ORDER BY b.ord

panels.title: 每型号业务总览
panels.description: 前台已知结果（成功交付、时间截断、其他上游失败）中，首字阶段超时或总截止仍未提交token的比例。v4早收到但晚提交仍计超时，迟到恢复不改写；离页、后台、手动停止和缺报均排除并单列。 每型号P50/P90/P95为同一请求总时间的分位数，不能把首发与兜底分位数相加。 “首发等待”现为启动兜底阈值；“兜底预留时间”用于前置过慢时提前启动。上线前历史仍按旧阶段硬时限解释，请按实际生产上线时刻分窗。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id) AS "型号", count(*) AS "请求量", 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE server_first_token_timeout OR server_timeout_stage IN ('global','primary','fallback'))/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "系统无首字截断率", 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE ((recoverable_delivery AND client_delivery_failed) OR (NOT recoverable_delivery AND client_outcome='timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS "前台首字等待超时率",
 percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false AND (measurement_method IS DISTINCT FROM 'client_committed_v4' OR client_first_token_visible_ms < first_token_deadline_ms))/1000.0 AS "客户端首字交付 P90",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE fallback_started)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "兜底触发率",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='timed_out' AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS "前台已知结果超时率",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome<>'missing')/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "回报覆盖率",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "旧总截止口径可判定占比",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false AND (measurement_method IS DISTINCT FROM 'client_committed_v4' OR client_first_token_visible_ms < first_token_deadline_ms)) AS "前台已交付样本",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='timed_out' AND client_backgrounded=false) AS "前台超时样本",
 percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false AND (measurement_method IS DISTINCT FROM 'client_committed_v4' OR client_first_token_visible_ms < first_token_deadline_ms))/1000.0 AS "客户端首字交付 P50",
 percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false AND (measurement_method IS DISTINCT FROM 'client_committed_v4' OR client_first_token_visible_ms < first_token_deadline_ms))/1000.0 AS "客户端首字交付 P95",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE delivery_role='fallback' AND client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false AND (measurement_method IS DISTINCT FROM 'client_committed_v4' OR client_first_token_visible_ms < first_token_deadline_ms))/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false AND (measurement_method IS DISTINCT FROM 'client_committed_v4' OR client_first_token_visible_ms < first_token_deadline_ms)),0) AS "已交付样本中兜底占比",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='missing') AS "缺报请求",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='not_observed') AS "其他未观测请求", requested_model_id AS "目录型号ID", primary_timeout_ms/1000.0 AS "首发等待",fallback_timeout_ms/1000.0 AS "兜底预留时间",first_token_deadline_ms/1000.0 AS "总等待上限",
100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome='timed_out' OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS "首字交付失败率",
count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome='timed_out' OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false) AS "首字交付失败样本",
percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_wait_finished_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_backgrounded=false)/1000.0 AS "含失败的实际等待 P90"
, count(*) FILTER(WHERE ((recoverable_delivery AND client_delivery_failed) OR (NOT recoverable_delivery AND client_outcome='timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false) AS "无字时间截断样本", count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false) AS "前台已知结果样本", 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "前台已知结果占比", count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_backgrounded=false AND client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason='upstream_error') AS "其他错误无字样本"
, count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_reason='page_left' OR client_backgrounded=true) AS "离页或后台请求", count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_reason='cancelled') AS "手动停止请求"
FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (measurement_method IS NULL AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v3' AND recoverable_delivery) OR (NOT recoverable_delivery AND client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY requested_model_id,primary_timeout_ms,fallback_timeout_ms,first_token_deadline_ms ORDER BY count(*) DESC,requested_model_id

含失败的实际等待 P90
旧总截止口径可判定占比

panels.title: 客户端首字交付 P90 · 各型号
panels.description: 每5分钟前台成功交付首token的P90。v4从点击到React提交，包含首发、兜底、网络与客户端处理；仅统计严格早于截止的成功样本，不由两段P90相加，缺报和失败不补技术耗时。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), concat(COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id), ' [', requested_model_id, ']') AS metric, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false AND (measurement_method IS DISTINCT FROM 'client_committed_v4' OR client_first_token_visible_ms < first_token_deadline_ms))/1000.0 AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (measurement_method IS NULL AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v3' AND recoverable_delivery) OR (NOT recoverable_delivery AND client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,requested_model_id ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 兜底触发率 · 各型号
panels.description: 已触发兜底的请求/全部有效请求，包含触发后仍超时或失败的请求；不是只看成功兜底。 启动后首发仍可获胜；实际替代比例看总览的“已交付样本中兜底占比”，两者不能混用。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), concat(COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id), ' [', requested_model_id, ']') AS metric, 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE fallback_started)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (measurement_method IS NULL AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v3' AND recoverable_delivery) OR (NOT recoverable_delivery AND client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,requested_model_id ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 客户端回报覆盖率 · 各型号
panels.description: 收到任意客户端最终报告的请求/该版本全部有效请求。v4在请求受理时保存版本，缺报仍在分母；离页、停止、错误报告计覆盖，不等于成功交付。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), concat(COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id), ' [', requested_model_id, ']') AS metric, 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome<>'missing')/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (measurement_method IS NULL AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v3' AND recoverable_delivery) OR (NOT recoverable_delivery AND client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,requested_model_id ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 人工调整对照 · 同型号按当轮等待配置分组
panels.description: 同型号、同观测版本按配置版本、首发等待、兜底预留时间、总上限、兜底型号分组；“首发等待”现为启动兜底阈值。先按实际生产上线时刻分窗：上线前兜底值表示旧硬时限，不能与相同数值的新预留策略合组。v4的150门槛只用v4请求数；各参数组仍须单看样本量，仅供人工调整。

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'provider_model_id',''),j->>'model_id') AS "型号",(j->>'model_requests')::int AS "型号总请求",(j->>'sample_eligible')::boolean AS "型号达到150样本",(j->>'requests')::int AS "本组请求",(j->>'primary_timeout_ms')::numeric/1000.0 AS "首发等待",(j->>'first_token_deadline_ms')::numeric/1000.0 AS "总等待上限",(j->>'fallback_timeout_ms')::numeric/1000.0 AS "兜底预留时间",j->>'fallback_model_id' AS "兜底型号",(j->>'user_first_token_p90_ms')::numeric/1000.0 AS "客户端首字交付 P90",100*(j->>'fallback_start_rate')::numeric AS "兜底触发率",100*(j->>'foreground_first_token_failure_rate_known')::numeric AS "首字交付失败率",100*(j->>'foreground_time_cutoff_rate_known')::numeric AS "前台首字等待超时率",100*(j->>'client_report_coverage')::numeric AS "回报覆盖率",(j->>'catalog_version')::int AS "配置版本",j->>'model_id' AS "目录型号ID" FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_report($__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) j WHERE ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR j->>'model_id' IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND (j->>'measurement_method'=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (j->>'measurement_method' IS NULL AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v3' AND (j->>'recoverable_delivery')::boolean) OR (NOT (j->>'recoverable_delivery')::boolean AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND j->>'fallback_timeout_ms' IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND j->>'fallback_timeout_ms' IS NULL)))))) ORDER BY j->>'model_id',(j->>'catalog_version')::int,(j->>'primary_timeout_ms')::int

matcher.options: 已交付样本中兜底占比
